definition_zh: 流感；流行性感冒
definition_en: a common illness caused by a virus, with fever, aches, and tiredness
core_image: 一个人裹着毯子躺在床上，额头滚烫，旁边放着药片
scene: 他得了流感，卧床休息。He caught the flu and stayed in bed.
sceneCN: 这里 flu 是「流感」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他得了流感，卧床休息。

senses.title: The illness
senses.definition: a viral illness with fever and body aches
senses.definitionCN: 伴有发烧和全身酸痛的病毒性疾病
senses.example: He caught the flu and stayed in bed.
senses.why: This is the everyday short form of influenza.
senses.whyCN: 这是 influenza 的日常简称。

senses.title: A case of flu
senses.definition: an instance of being infected with the flu
senses.example: The clinic treated twenty flu cases.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所治疗了二十个流感病例。
senses.why: The illness name also counts individual cases.
senses.whyCN: 疾病名称也可指一个个病例。

senses.title: The flu season
senses.definition: the period when flu spreads widely
senses.example: Flu season starts in late autumn.
senses.why: The short name labels the season itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个简称也可直接指流感季节。

intro.en: Flu is a clipped form of influenza, an Italian word for influence.
intro.cn: flu 是 influenza 的截短形式，而 influenza 是意大利语中表示「影响」的词。

items.en: Influenza meant an influence, especially from the stars.
items.cn: influenza 意为影响，尤指星辰的影响。

items.en: Influenza entered English as the name of a disease.
items.cn: influenza 进入英语，成为疾病名称。

items.en: Speakers cut influenza down to flu.
items.cn: 说话者把 influenza 缩短为 flu。

items.en: Flu became the normal word in everyday speech.
items.cn: flu 成为日常口语中的常用词。

items.en: Compounds such as bird flu spread worldwide.
items.cn: bird flu 等复合词传遍世界。

note.en: Flu is compared with similar-looking words and with words for illness.
note.cn: 把 flu 与形近词以及表示疾病的词作比较。

entries.definition: a pipe that carries smoke away
a mild illness of the nose and throat
the full medical name for flu
a tiny agent that causes disease

normalIntro.en: Flu is the short, sharp name for a virus that puts you in bed.
normalIntro.cn: flu 是让一个病毒性疾病的简短名称，得了就要卧床。

normal.en: The flu kept him home for a week.

abstract.en: A short word can carry a long illness.
abstract.cn: 一个短词可以承载一场漫长的病。

abstract.en: Flu travels faster than any train.
abstract.cn: 流感比任何火车传播得都快。

abstract.en: Coughs share the flu without asking.
abstract.cn: 咳嗽不打招呼就分享了流感。

examples.en: He caught the flu and stayed in bed.
The clinic treated twenty flu cases.
examples.cn: 诊所治疗了二十个流感病例。

examples.en: Flu season starts in late autumn.

dict_mnemonic.text: flu 是 influenza 的截短词，记住「短名字，重感冒」即可。

root: 截短自意大利语 influenza（影响），核心义「流传广泛的病毒性疾病」。

sensesIntro.en: Flu means the illness, a case of it, or the season when it spreads.
sensesIntro.cn: flu 意为流感、流感病例或流感季。

core.en: A virus that spreads through the air and lays people low.
core.cn: 通过空气传播、让人倒下的病毒。

branches.en: The illness itself.
One person's infection.
The months when it spreads.
The disease and its cases share one name.
branches.cn: 疾病与病例共用一个名称。

branches.en: Season turns a virus into a calendar event.
branches.cn: 季节把病毒变成日历上的事件。

intro.en: Flu forms a small family of illness compounds.
intro.cn: flu 形成一个小型疾病复合词族。

latinIntro.en: Flu comes from Italian influenza; Latin influentia, influence, is its distant source.
latinIntro.cn: flu 来自意大利语 influenza；拉丁语 influentia（影响）是其远源。

items.example: The ward filled with flus last winter.
items.exampleCN: 去年冬天病房里住满了流感病人。

items.example: She felt fluish and went home.
items.exampleCN: 她觉得有点流感症状就回家了。

items.example: Get a flu shot before winter.

items.exampleCN: 流感季在一月达到高峰。

items.example: Bird flu can cross into humans.

items.meaning: an illness with vomiting and diarrhoea
items.example: Stomach flu spreads quickly in schools.
items.exampleCN: 胃肠型流感在学校传播很快。

definition_zh: 流利的；流畅的；熟练的
definition_en: able to speak a language smoothly, or moving and expressed with ease
core_image: 一个人说着外语，句子像水一样连续不断地流出来
scene: 她说一口流利的英语。She speaks fluent English.
sceneCN: 这里 fluent 是「流利的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她说一口流利的英语。

senses.title: Smooth speech
senses.definition: able to speak a language easily and well
senses.definitionCN: 能轻松而出色地说一门语言
senses.example: She speaks fluent English.
senses.why: This is the most common modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最常见的义项。

senses.title: Smooth expression
senses.definition: expressed in a smooth, natural way
senses.definitionCN: 以流畅自然的方式表达的
senses.example: His writing is clear and fluent.
senses.why: The idea of smooth flow extends to writing.
senses.whyCN: 流畅的概念延伸到写作。

senses.title: Skilled movement
senses.definition: moving with ease and skill
senses.example: The dancer made fluent movements.
senses.why: Smooth language and smooth motion share one image.
senses.whyCN: 流畅的语言与流畅的动作共享一个意象。

intro.en: Fluent comes from Latin fluere, to flow.
intro.cn: fluent 来自拉丁语 fluere，意为流动。

items.en: Fluere meant to flow like water.
items.cn: fluere 意为像水一样流动。

items.en: Fluens described something flowing freely.
items.cn: fluens 形容自由流动的东西。

items.en: Fluent described smooth, flowing speech.
items.cn: fluent 形容流畅的言语。

items.en: Fluent extended to writing and movement.
items.cn: fluent 扩展到写作与动作。

items.en: Fluency became a goal for language learners.
items.cn: fluency 成为语言学习者的目标。

note.en: Fluent is compared with similar-looking words and with words for ease and flow.
note.cn: 把 fluent 与形近词以及表示轻松和流动的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Fluent speech flows like water: no bumps, no stops.
normalIntro.cn: fluent 的语言像水一样流：不磕绊、不停顿。

normal.cn: 他做了一次流畅的演讲。
她流利的法语让我们印象深刻。

normal.en: The dancer moved in a fluent way.

abstract.en: Fluency hides years of practice.
abstract.cn: 流利掩盖了多年的练习。

abstract.en: Water and words both find the easy path.
abstract.cn: 水与话语都会找到顺畅的路径。

abstract.en: A fluent line never shows where it stopped.
abstract.cn: 流畅的线条从不停下来给人看。

examples.en: She speaks fluent English.
His writing is clear and fluent.
The dancer made fluent movements.

dict_mnemonic.text: fluent 的词根 flu 就是「流」，说话像流水一样不断，就是流利。

root: 源自拉丁语 fluere（流动），核心义「像水一样顺畅地流出」。

sensesIntro.en: Fluent means smooth in speech, smooth in expression, or skilled in movement.
sensesIntro.cn: fluent 意为语言流利的、表达流畅的或动作熟练的。

core.en: Words or movement that flow without effort.
core.cn: 毫不费力地流动的话语或动作。

branches.en: Speech that runs like water.
Writing with no rough joins.
Motion that shows no strain.
Speech and writing share the same smoothness.
branches.cn: 口语与写作共享同一种流畅。

branches.en: Skill makes both words and bodies flow.
branches.cn: 技巧让话语与身体都流动起来。

intro.en: Fluent forms a family of flow and smoothness words.
intro.cn: fluent 形成一个表示流动与顺畅的词族。

latinIntro.en: Fluent contains Latin fluere, to flow, a root shared with fluid and flush.
latinIntro.cn: fluent 含有拉丁语 fluere（流动），与 fluid、flush 共享词根。

items.exampleCN: 他的流利程度随练习提高。

items.example: The influent stream feeds the lake.
They live in an affluent area.

items.exampleCN: 两条汇流的河在此相遇。

items.example: The refluent tide pulled the boat.
items.exampleCN: 倒流的潮水拉动了小船。

definition_zh: 流体；液体；流动的；易变的
definition_en: a substance that flows, or something that is smooth, moving, and likely to change
core_image: 水从倾斜的杯中流出，形状随容器而变
scene: 水是一种常见的流体。Water is a common fluid.
sceneCN: 这里 fluid 是「流体」（第 1 个义项）；句意：水是一种常见的流体。

senses.title: Flowing substance
senses.definition: a gas or liquid that flows freely
senses.definitionCN: 能自由流动的气体或液体
senses.example: Water is a common fluid.
senses.why: This is the scientific sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是科学上的义项。

senses.title: Liquid
senses.definition: a liquid, especially in the body
senses.example: Drink plenty of fluids when ill.
senses.why: Everyday speech narrows fluid to drinkable liquid.
senses.whyCN: 日常用语把 fluid 缩小为可饮用的液体。

senses.title: Flowing
senses.definition: moving smoothly and easily
senses.example: The dancer had a fluid style.
senses.why: The noun quality becomes an adjective.
senses.whyCN: 名词的性质转为形容词。

senses.title: Changeable
senses.definition: likely to change; not fixed
senses.example: The situation is still fluid.
senses.why: What flows cannot stay fixed in shape.
senses.whyCN: 会流动的东西无法保持固定形状。

intro.en: Fluid comes from Latin fluidus, flowing, from fluere, to flow.
intro.cn: fluid 来自拉丁语 fluidus（流动的），源头是 fluere（流动）。

items.en: Fluere meant to flow.
items.cn: fluere 意为流动。

items.en: Fluidus described something that flows.
items.cn: fluidus 形容会流动的东西。

items.en: Fluid named liquids and gases in science.
items.cn: fluid 在科学中命名液体与气体。

items.en: Fluid described smooth movement and style.
items.cn: fluid 形容流畅的动作与风格。

items.en: Fluid extended to situations that may change.
items.cn: fluid 扩展到可能变化的局势。

note.en: Fluid is compared with similar-looking words and with words for liquids and change.
note.cn: 把 fluid 与形近词以及表示液体和变化的词作比较。

entries.definition: a substance that flows and takes the shape of its container
a substance that fills any space

normalIntro.en: Fluid is anything that flows, and anything that keeps changing shape.
normalIntro.cn: fluid 是任何会流动、形状不断变化的东西。

abstract.en: A fluid has no shape of its own.
abstract.cn: 流体没有自己的形状。

abstract.en: Plans stay fluid until the last minute.
abstract.cn: 计划直到最后一刻都保持可变。

abstract.en: Water teaches that strength can bend.
abstract.cn: 水告诉我们力量也可以弯曲。

examples.en: Water is a common fluid.
Drink plenty of fluids when ill.
The situation is still fluid.

dict_mnemonic.text: fluid 与 flu、fluent 同根，都是「流」：会流的物质叫流体，会变的状态叫易变。

root: 源自拉丁语 fluere（流动），核心义「能流动、无固定形状」。

sensesIntro.en: Fluid means a flowing substance, a liquid, flowing movement, or something changeable.
sensesIntro.cn: fluid 意为流体、液体、流动的或易变的。

core.en: A substance with no fixed shape.
core.cn: 没有固定形状的物质。

branches.en: Gas or liquid in motion.
Liquid taken into the body.
Movement without rough edges.
A state that has not settled.
Smooth motion and easy change share one adjective.
branches.cn: 流畅的动作与容易的改变共用一个形容词。

intro.en: Fluid forms a family of flow and change words.
intro.cn: fluid 形成一个表示流动与变化的词族。

latinIntro.en: Fluid comes from Latin fluidus, a form built on fluere, to flow.
latinIntro.cn: fluid 来自拉丁语 fluidus，由 fluere（流动）构成。

items.example: Keep all fluids away from the machine.
Heat increases the fluidity of wax.
He moved fluidly across the stage.

items.meaning: to make flow like a fluid
a fluid that flows without resistance

definition_zh: 飞；飞翔；乘飞机；驾驶飞机；飞逝
definition_en: to move through the air, travel by plane, pilot an aircraft, wave in the wind, or pass quickly
core_image: 一只鸟张开翅膀，越过湖面飞向远处的树林
scene: 鸟飞过湖面。A bird flew over the lake.
sceneCN: 这里 fly 是「飞」（第 1 个义项）；句意：鸟飞过湖面。

senses.title: Move through air
senses.definition: to move through the air with wings or power
senses.definitionCN: 靠翅膀或动力在空中移动
senses.example: A bird flew over the lake.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Travel by plane
senses.definition: to travel in an aircraft
senses.example: We will fly to Beijing tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 我们明天乘飞机去北京。
senses.why: People fly as passengers too.
senses.whyCN: 人也能作为乘客飞行。

senses.title: Pilot
senses.definition: to control an aircraft in flight
senses.example: She flies a small plane.
senses.why: The verb can name the pilot's action.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词也可指飞行员的操作。

senses.title: Wave in air
senses.definition: to move freely in the wind
senses.example: Flags fly above the square.
senses.why: Cloth moves through air like a wing.
senses.whyCN: 布像翅膀一样在空中移动。

senses.title: Pass quickly
senses.definition: to pass very quickly
senses.example: The summer flew by.
senses.why: Time is imagined as flying.
senses.whyCN: 时间被想象成在飞。

intro.en: Fly comes from an Old English word for moving through the air.
intro.cn: fly 来自古英语中表示在空中移动的词。

items.en: Fleogan meant to fly with wings.
items.cn: fleogan 意为用翅膀飞行。

items.en: Fleuganan carried the same airy sense.
items.cn: fleuganan 带有同样的空中含义。

items.en: Fly extended to travel by aircraft.
items.cn: fly 扩展到乘飞机旅行。

items.en: Fly described flags and hair moving in wind.
items.cn: fly 形容旗帜和头发在风中飘动。

items.en: Time flies became a common saying.
items.cn: time flies 成为常用俗语。

note.en: Fly is compared with similar-looking words and with words for air travel.
note.cn: 把 fly 与形近词以及表示空中飞行的词作比较。

entries.definition: to fly high in the air
to go from one place to another

normalIntro.en: Fly is a bird, a passenger, a pilot, a flag, and time itself moving through air.
normalIntro.cn: fly 可以是鸟、乘客、飞行员、旗帜，也可以是穿过空气的时间。

normal.en: We fly to Shanghai on Monday.
normal.cn: 我们周一乘飞机去上海。

normal.en: The flag flies in the wind.
Time flies when you are busy.

abstract.en: A plane is a metal bird with a schedule.
abstract.cn: 飞机是一只有时刻表的金属鸟。

abstract.en: Flags fly because they are tied down.
abstract.cn: 旗帜能飘扬是因为它被系住了。

abstract.en: Time flies only when we look back.
abstract.cn: 只有回头看时，时间才显得飞快。

examples.en: A bird flew over the lake.
We will fly to Beijing tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我们明天乘飞机去北京。

examples.en: The summer flew by.

dict_mnemonic.text: fly 的核心是「离地而行」：鸟飞、人坐飞机飞、旗子被风带着飞、时间也飞。

root: 源自古英语 fleogan（用翅膀飞行），核心义「在空中移动」。

sensesIntro.en: Fly means to move through air, travel by plane, pilot a plane, wave in wind, or pass quickly.
sensesIntro.cn: fly 意为飞、乘飞机、驾驶飞机、飘动或飞逝。

core.en: Leaving the ground and moving through air.
core.cn: 离开地面并在空中移动。

branches.en: A bird beats its wings and rises.
A passenger boards a plane.
A pilot controls the aircraft.
Cloth waves in the wind.
Time seems to pass on wings.

intro.en: Fly forms a family of flight and travel words.
intro.cn: fly 形成一个表示飞行与旅行的词族。

latinIntro.en: Fly has no Latin ancestor; Latin volare, to fly, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: fly 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 volare（飞）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The eagle flies above the valley.
She flies every week for work.
They flew to Tokyo last night.
He has flown this route for years.
Flying fish leap from the water.

items.meaning: a pilot or a printed sheet

definition_zh: 焦点；聚焦；集中；重点
definition_en: the point where light or attention meets, or to direct attention or a lens there
core_image: 放大镜把阳光聚成一点，纸面冒起一缕烟
scene: 请把注意力集中在题目上。Please focus on the question.
sceneCN: 这里 focus 是「集中」（第 2 个义项）；句意：请把注意力集中在题目上。

senses.title: Point of light
senses.definition: the point where rays of light meet
senses.example: Adjust the lens until the image is in focus.
senses.exampleCN: 调节镜头直到图像清晰对焦。
senses.why: This is the original optical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最初的光学义项。

senses.title: To concentrate
senses.definition: to direct attention toward something
senses.example: Please focus on the question.
senses.exampleCN: 请把注意力集中在题目上。
senses.why: Attention is treated like a beam of light.
senses.whyCN: 注意力被当作一束光。

senses.title: To adjust a lens
senses.definition: to make an image clear by moving a lens
senses.example: She focused the camera on the bird.
senses.exampleCN: 她把相机对准鸟儿对焦。
senses.why: The verb keeps the optical action.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留了光学的动作。

senses.title: Main point
senses.definition: the central subject of attention
senses.example: Cost is the main focus of the report.
senses.exampleCN: 成本是这份报告的重点。
senses.why: The meeting point of rays becomes a topic.
senses.whyCN: 光线的汇聚点引申为话题。

intro.en: Focus is Latin for hearth, the fireplace at the centre of a home.
intro.cn: focus 在拉丁语中意为壁炉，即家宅中央的火塘。

items.en: Focus meant a hearth or fireplace.
items.cn: focus 意为壁炉或火塘。

items.en: Opticians used focus for the point of rays.
items.cn: 光学家用 focus 表示光线的汇聚点。

items.en: Focus entered English as an optical term.
items.cn: focus 作为光学术语进入英语。

items.en: Focus extended to attention and importance.
items.cn: focus 扩展到注意力与重要性。

items.en: Focus became a common verb meaning concentrate.
items.cn: focus 成为表示集中的常用动词。

note.en: Focus is compared with similar-looking words and with words for attention and centres.
note.cn: 把 focus 与形近词以及表示注意力和中心的词作比较。

entries.definition: trickery, used in the phrase hocus-pocus
the act of watching or listening carefully

normalIntro.en: Focus is a meeting point: light, attention, or the main topic all gather there.
normalIntro.cn: focus 是一个汇聚点：光、注意力或主要话题都在那里聚集。

normal.en: He lost focus during the lecture.
Focus the light on the paper.

abstract.en: Attention is a beam you can point.
abstract.cn: 注意力是一束可以指向的光。

abstract.en: A clear focus leaves the rest blurred.
abstract.cn: 清晰的焦点让其余部分变模糊。

abstract.en: A hearth and a lens both gather people and light.
abstract.cn: 火塘聚人，镜头聚光。

examples.en: Please focus on the question.
examples.cn: 请把注意力集中在题目上。

examples.en: She focused the camera on the bird.
examples.cn: 她把相机对准鸟儿对焦。

examples.en: Cost is the main focus of the report.
examples.cn: 成本是这份报告的重点。

dict_mnemonic.text: focus 原指家中火塘，是一家人目光汇聚之处；后来指光线汇聚的焦点，再指注意力的集中点。

root: 源自拉丁语 focus（火塘、壁炉），核心义「汇聚的中心点」。

sensesIntro.en: Focus means an optical point, to concentrate, to adjust a lens, or the main point.
sensesIntro.cn: focus 意为焦点、集中、对焦或重点。

core.en: A point where rays or attention come together.
core.cn: 光线或注意力汇聚的一点。

branches.en: Light rays meet at one point.
The mind gathers on one task.
branches.cn: 心思聚集在一项任务上。

branches.en: The lens is moved until clear.
A report centres on one subject.
Light and attention follow the same geometry.
branches.cn: 光与注意力遵循同样的几何。

intro.en: Focus forms a family of attention and lens words.
intro.cn: focus 形成一个表示注意力与镜头的词族。

latinIntro.en: Focus is a Latin word for hearth; it has no productive Latin affixes.
latinIntro.cn: focus 是拉丁语中表示火塘的词；它在拉丁语中没有能产后缀。

items.exampleCN: 她给出了重点明确的回答。

items.example: Let us refocus on the plan.

items.meaning: a camera system that focuses itself
items.exampleCN: 这部手机自动对焦很快。

definition_zh: 雾；迷雾；起雾；使模糊
definition_en: a thick cloud near the ground, a state of confusion, or to cover something with mist
core_image: 清晨的街道被白雾吞没，路灯只剩一圈模糊的光
scene: 浓雾笼罩着整条街。Thick fog covered the whole street.
sceneCN: 这里 fog 是「雾」（第 1 个义项）；句意：浓雾笼罩着整条街。

senses.title: Ground cloud
senses.definition: a thick cloud of tiny water drops near the ground
senses.definitionCN: 贴近地面的浓密小水滴云团
senses.example: Thick fog covered the whole street.
senses.why: This is the basic weather sense.

latinIntro.en: Food has no Latin ancestor; Latin cibus, food, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: food 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 cibus（食物）只是语义对应词。

items.example: There is enough food for everyone.
items.exampleCN: 有足够的食物给每个人。

items.example: My cousin is a real foodie.
items.exampleCN: 我表弟是个十足的美食家。
面粉是基本的食品原料。
没有食物的一天很难熬。

items.meaning: fish and shellfish eaten as food
items.example: The town is famous for seafood.

items.meaning: food said to be especially healthy

items.example: He eats fast food too often.

definition_zh: 脚；英尺；底部；支付
definition_en: the part of the body you stand on, a unit of length, the bottom of something, or to pay a bill
core_image: 赤脚踩在湿沙上，留下清晰的脚印
scene: 我在山脚下等他们。I waited for them at the foot of the hill.
sceneCN: 这里 foot 是「底部」（第 3 个义项）；句意：我在山脚下等他们。

collocations.phrase: get off on the wrong foot

senses.title: Body part
senses.definition: the part of the leg at the bottom that you stand on
senses.definitionCN: 腿最下端用来站立的部分
senses.example: My left foot hurts.
senses.why: This is the basic body sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的身体义项。

senses.title: Unit of length
senses.definition: a unit of length equal to twelve inches
senses.definitionCN: 等于十二英寸的长度单位
senses.example: The room is ten feet wide.
senses.why: The length was once based on a foot.
senses.whyCN: 这个长度单位最初以脚为基础。

senses.title: Bottom
senses.definition: the lowest part of something
senses.example: I waited for them at the foot of the hill.
senses.why: The foot is the lowest part of the body.
senses.whyCN: 脚是身体最低的部分。

senses.title: To pay
senses.definition: to pay for something, especially a bill
senses.example: His parents footed the bill.
senses.why: Paying is imagined as standing the cost.
senses.whyCN: 付钱被想象成站住这笔开销。

intro.en: Foot comes from an ancient Germanic word for the body part.
intro.cn: foot 来自日耳曼语中表示这个身体部位的古老词。

items.en: Fot meant the foot of a person or animal.
items.cn: fot 指人或动物的脚。

items.en: Fotuz carried the same body sense.
items.cn: fotuz 带有同样的身体含义。

items.en: Foot also named the base of an object.
items.cn: foot 也开始指物体的底部。

items.en: Foot became a standard unit of length.
items.cn: foot 成为标准长度单位。

items.en: Foot the bill became a common phrase.
items.cn: foot the bill 成为常用短语。

note.en: Foot is compared with similar-looking words and with words for base and payment.
note.cn: 把 foot 与形近词以及表示底部和支付的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Foot is the base of the body, of a hill, and even of a bill.
normalIntro.cn: foot 是身体、山乃至账单的「底」。

normal.en: The table is three feet long.
We camped at the foot of the mountain.
She goes to school on foot.
The company will foot the bill.

abstract.en: A foot measures both distance and standing ground.
abstract.cn: 脚既丈量距离，也提供立足之地。

abstract.en: Every mountain has a foot and every story a start.
abstract.cn: 每座山都有山脚，每个故事都有起点。

abstract.en: To foot a bill is to carry its weight.
abstract.cn: 付账就是承担它的重量。

examples.en: I waited for them at the foot of the hill.
The room is ten feet wide.
His parents footed the bill.

dict_mnemonic.text: foot 的核心是「最下面的支撑」：人的脚、山的脚、账单的脚（付账）。

root: 源自古英语 fot（脚），核心义「最下端的支撑部分」。

sensesIntro.en: Foot means the body part, a length unit, the bottom, or to pay.
sensesIntro.cn: foot 意为脚、英尺、底部或支付。

core.en: The lowest supporting part.
core.cn: 最下端的支撑部分。

branches.en: The body part that stands.
A length once measured by a foot.
The base of a hill or page.
Standing the cost of a bill.
The body part names every base.
branches.cn: 身体部位命名了各种底部。

intro.en: Foot forms a wide family of body, base, and movement words.
intro.cn: foot 形成一个庞大的身体、底部与移动词族。

latinIntro.en: Foot has no Latin ancestor; Latin pes, foot, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: foot 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 pes（脚）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The bill was footed by the host.
He lost his footing on the ice.

items.meaning: a line at the bottom of a page
items.example: The page number is in the footer.

items.meaning: a mark left by a foot
items.example: We found footprints in the sand.
items.exampleCN: 我们在沙里发现了脚印。

definition_zh: 足球运动；足球；橄榄球；足球比赛
definition_en: a game played with a ball and two teams, the ball itself, American football, or a match
core_image: 绿茵场上，一名球员抬脚把黑白相间的足球踢向球门
scene: 男孩们在操场上踢足球。The boys are playing football on the playground.
sceneCN: 这里 football 是「足球运动」（第 1 个义项）；句意：男孩们在操场上踢足球。

senses.title: The game
senses.definition: a game in which two teams kick a ball into goals
senses.definitionCN: 两队把球踢进对方球门的运动
senses.example: The boys are playing football on the playground.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩们在操场上踢足球。
senses.why: This is the main British sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的英式义项。

senses.title: The ball
senses.definition: the ball used in this game
senses.example: He kicked the football over the wall.
senses.why: The game name also names its ball.
senses.whyCN: 运动名称也指它的球。

senses.title: American football
senses.definition: an American game with an oval ball and heavy contact
senses.definitionCN: 使用椭圆球、身体对抗激烈的美式运动
senses.example: American football is popular in autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 美式橄榄球在秋天很流行。
senses.why: The same word names a different game abroad.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词在国外指另一项运动。

senses.title: A match
senses.definition: a single football game
senses.example: We watched a football on Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们周六看了一场足球比赛。
senses.why: Informal British use drops match.
senses.whyCN: 英式口语省略了 match。

intro.en: Football joins foot and ball, a game played on foot rather than on horseback.
intro.cn: football 由 foot 与 ball 组成，指用脚而非骑马进行的球类运动。

items.en: Fot ball named games played on foot.
items.cn: fot ball 指用脚进行的球类游戏。

items.en: Football split into rugby and association codes.
items.cn: football 分化为橄榄球与足球两种规则。

items.en: Association football became the global game.
items.cn: 英式足球成为全球性运动。

items.en: American football kept the older name in the US.
items.cn: 美式橄榄球在美国保留了旧名称。

items.en: Football clubs became major institutions.
items.cn: 足球俱乐部成为重要机构。

note.en: Football is compared with similar-looking compounds and with other ball games.
note.cn: 把 football 与形近复合词以及其他球类运动作比较。

entries.definition: a low stool for the feet
the American name for association football
a game with an oval ball and tackling
a sports game between two sides

normalIntro.en: Football is a ball moved by feet, and the name travels with the game.
normalIntro.cn: football 是用脚推动的球，这个名字也跟着运动走遍世界。

normal.en: The football match starts at eight.
The football rolled into the road.

abstract.en: A football game is a story with no script.
abstract.cn: 足球比赛是没有剧本的故事。

abstract.en: One ball can gather a whole city.
abstract.cn: 一个球能让整座城市聚在一起。

abstract.en: The name says foot, but the game is played with the head too.
abstract.cn: 名字说用脚，但这项运动也用头。

examples.en: The boys are playing football on the playground.
examples.cn: 男孩们在操场上踢足球。

examples.en: He kicked the football over the wall.
American football is popular in autumn.
examples.cn: 美式橄榄球在秋天很流行。

dict_mnemonic.text: football 就是 foot 加 ball：用脚踢的球，以及围绕这个球建立的整项运动。

root: 由 foot 与 ball 复合而成，核心义「用脚踢球的运动」。

sensesIntro.en: Football means the game, its ball, American football, or a match.
sensesIntro.cn: football 意为足球运动、足球、橄榄球或足球比赛。

core.en: A game of feet, a ball, and two goals.
core.cn: 关于脚、球和两个球门的运动。

branches.en: Two teams chase one ball.
The ball itself rolls away.
An oval ball in another country.
Ninety minutes of a single game.
The game and the ball share one name.
branches.cn: 运动与球共用一个名称。

intro.en: Football forms a family of players and the sport itself.
intro.cn: football 形成一个表示球员与这项运动的词族。

latinIntro.en: Football has no Latin ancestor; its parts are Old English foot and ball.
latinIntro.cn: football 没有拉丁语来源；其组成部分是古英语的 foot 与 ball。

items.example: The football match ended in a draw.
items.exampleCN: 这场足球比赛以平局结束。
我们的足球队每天训练。

definition_zh: 脚步；脚步声；足迹；前人的道路
definition_en: the sound or act of a step, a mark left by a foot, or the path someone has taken before
core_image: 空荡的走廊里，远处传来一下一下由远及近的脚步声
scene: 楼梯上传来轻轻的脚步声。Light footsteps came from the stairs.
sceneCN: 这里 footstep 是「脚步声」（第 2 个义项）；句意：楼梯上传来轻轻的脚步声。

senses.title: A step
senses.definition: the act of moving the foot once
senses.example: He took one footstep forward.
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Sound of a step
senses.definition: the sound made by a foot moving
senses.example: Light footsteps came from the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 楼梯上传来轻轻的脚步声。
senses.why: The act is heard before it is seen.
senses.whyCN: 动作先被听见，再被看见。

senses.title: A mark
senses.definition: a mark left by a foot on the ground
senses.example: Footsteps led across the snow.
senses.why: Each step can leave a trace.
senses.whyCN: 每一步都可能留下痕迹。

senses.title: Someone's path
senses.definition: the example or career path of another person
senses.definitionCN: 他人留下的榜样或职业道路
senses.example: She followed in her mother's footsteps.
senses.why: Walking where another walked becomes a metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 走在别人走过的路上成为比喻。

intro.en: Footstep joins foot and step, two Old English words.
intro.cn: footstep 由 foot 与 step 两个古英语词组成。

items.en: Fot and stepp named foot and stride.
items.cn: fot 与 stepp 分别指脚与步子。

items.en: Footstep named the sound of walking.
items.cn: footstep 指走路的声音。

items.en: Footstep also named a mark on the ground.
items.cn: footstep 也指地上的痕迹。

items.en: Follow in someone's footsteps became an idiom.
items.cn: follow in someone's footsteps 成为习语。

items.en: Footstep appeared in detective and ghost stories.
items.cn: footstep 常出现在侦探与鬼故事中。

note.en: Footstep is compared with similar compounds and with words for steps and marks.
note.cn: 把 footstep 与形近复合词以及表示脚步和痕迹的词作比较。

entries.definition: a low stool for the feet

normalIntro.en: A footstep is a step you can hear, see, or choose to follow.
normalIntro.cn: footstep 是能听见、能看见，也能选择追随的一步。

normal.en: His footsteps were heavy on the stairs.
normal.cn: 他在楼梯上的脚步声很重。

normal.en: She followed in her father's footsteps.
The footsteps faded into the night.

abstract.en: Every path is a line of old footsteps.
abstract.cn: 每条路都是一串旧脚印。

abstract.en: The sound of a step arrives before the person.
abstract.cn: 脚步声总比人先到。

abstract.en: To follow footsteps is to borrow another's courage.
abstract.cn: 追随脚步就是借用别人的勇气。

examples.en: Light footsteps came from the stairs.
examples.cn: 楼梯上传来轻轻的脚步声。

examples.en: Footsteps led across the snow.
She followed in her mother's footsteps.

dict_mnemonic.text: footstep 是 foot 加 step：脚落下的一步，能听见声音、留下痕迹，也能成为后人跟随的路。

root: 由 foot 与 step 复合而成，核心义「脚落下的一步及其痕迹」。

sensesIntro.en: Footstep means a step, its sound, its mark, or another person's path.
sensesIntro.cn: footstep 意为脚步、脚步声、足迹或前人的道路。

core.en: One foot coming down and leaving something behind.
core.cn: 一只脚落下并留下些什么。

branches.en: A single movement of the foot.
A sound in an empty hall.
A print left in snow.
A parent's path taken again.
Physical traces become a guide for life.
branches.cn: 物理痕迹成为人生指引。

intro.en: Footstep forms a small family of walking-sound words.
intro.cn: footstep 形成一个表示走路声音的小词族。

latinIntro.en: Footstep has no Latin ancestor; both its parts are Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: footstep 没有拉丁语来源；两部分都来自日耳曼语。

items.example: A footfall echoed in the hall.
The app plays a footstep sound.
They used footstep tracking in the snow.
items.exampleCN: 他们在雪地里用足印追踪。

items.example: The carpet kept the hall footstep-free.
items.exampleCN: 地毯让走廊没有脚步声。

definition_zh: 给；为了；持续；因为
definition_en: used to show the person receiving something, a purpose, a length of time, or a reason
core_image: 一份包好的礼物被递到对方手里，标签上写着「给你」
scene: 这份礼物是给你的。This gift is for you.
sceneCN: 这里 for 是「给」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这份礼物是给你的。

senses.title: Receiver
senses.definition: used to show the person who receives something
senses.definitionCN: 用来指出接受某物的人
senses.example: This gift is for you.
senses.why: This is the basic receiving sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的接受义项。

senses.title: Purpose
senses.definition: used to show a purpose or aim
senses.example: We met for a reason.
senses.why: The receiver becomes the goal of an action.
senses.whyCN: 接受者引申为行动的目标。

senses.title: Duration
senses.definition: used to show how long something continues
senses.definitionCN: 用来指出某事持续多久
senses.example: We walked for two hours.
senses.why: Purpose extends to a stretch of time.
senses.whyCN: 目的引申为一段时间。

senses.title: Because
senses.definition: used as a conjunction meaning because
senses.example: He left, for the night was late.
senses.why: The reason sense survives in formal writing.
senses.whyCN: 原因义保留在正式书面语中。

intro.en: For is one of the oldest English function words.
intro.cn: for 是英语中最古老的功能词之一。

items.en: For meant before, for, or because.
items.cn: for 意为在……之前、为了或因。

items.en: Furi carried the sense of going before.
items.cn: furi 带有走在前面之意。

items.en: For covered purpose, exchange, and duration.
items.cn: for 涵盖目的、交换与持续时间。

items.en: For became common in phrases like for free.
items.cn: for 在 for free 等短语中变得常见。

items.en: The because sense grew rare outside formal prose.
items.cn: 原因义在正式散文之外变得少见。

note.en: For is compared with similar-looking words and with other linking words.
note.cn: 把 for 与形近词以及其他连接词作比较。

normalIntro.en: For points from an action to its receiver, purpose, length, or reason.
normalIntro.cn: for 把动作指向接受者、目的、时长或原因。

normal.en: He was praised for his honesty.

abstract.en: For turns an action toward someone else.
abstract.cn: for 把动作转向别人。

abstract.en: A small word can carry time, cause, and gift.
abstract.cn: 一个小词能承载时间、原因与礼物。

abstract.en: Every purpose needs a direction.
abstract.cn: 每个目的都需要一个方向。

examples.en: This gift is for you.
We walked for two hours.
He left, for the night was late.

dict_mnemonic.text: for 是方向词：给谁、为什么、持续多久，都是把动作指向一个目标。

root: 源自古英语 for（在前、为了、因为），核心义「朝向某个目标」。

sensesIntro.en: For marks a receiver, a purpose, a duration, or a reason.
sensesIntro.cn: for 标记接受者、目的、持续时间或原因。

core.en: An arrow from an action to its target.
core.cn: 从动作指向目标的一支箭。

branches.en: A gift moves to its receiver.
An action aims at a goal.
Time is marked by a length.
branches.cn: 时间被标记为一段长度。

branches.en: A reason is given in formal prose.
Receiver and purpose are two ends of one arrow.
branches.cn: 接受者与目的是同一支箭的两端。

intro.en: The old prefix for- appears in many common verbs.
intro.cn: 古老前缀 for- 出现在许多常用动词中。

latinIntro.en: For and its prefix are Germanic; Latin pro, for, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: for 及其前缀属日耳曼语；拉丁语 pro（为了）只是语义对应词。

items.example: This note is for the teacher.
They would not forsake a friend.

items.exampleCN: 那只孤苦的狗在外面等着。

definition_zh: 禁止；不准；使不可能
definition_en: to order that something must not be done, or to make something impossible
core_image: 一只手掌竖在门前，掌心朝外，示意不许进入
scene: 医院里禁止吸烟。Smoking is forbidden in the hospital.
sceneCN: 这里 forbid 是「禁止」（第 1 个义项）；句意：医院里禁止吸烟。

senses.title: Order against
senses.definition: to order that something must not be done
senses.example: Smoking is forbidden in the hospital.
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的现代义项。

senses.title: Refuse permission
senses.definition: to refuse to allow someone to do something
senses.example: Her parents forbade her to go alone.
senses.why: The order is aimed at a person.
senses.whyCN: 这个命令指向具体的人。

senses.title: Make impossible
senses.definition: to make something impossible
senses.example: The storm forbade any attempt to sail.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨使任何出航尝试都不可能。
senses.why: A strong barrier forbids by circumstance.
senses.whyCN: 强大的阻碍以环境条件禁止。

intro.en: Forbid is an old compound of for- and bid, to command.
intro.cn: forbid 是 for- 与 bid（命令）构成的古老复合词。

items.en: Forbeodan meant to command against.
items.cn: forbeodan 意为下令禁止。

items.en: Forbede kept the sense of refusing permission.
items.cn: forbede 保留了不准许的含义。

items.en: Forbid extended to things made impossible.
items.cn: forbid 扩展到使不可能的事情。

items.en: Forbidden became common in rules and signs.
items.cn: forbidden 在规则与标牌中变得常见。

items.en: God forbid became a fixed expression.
items.cn: God forbid 成为固定表达。

note.en: Forbid is compared with similar-looking words and with words for banning.
note.cn: 把 forbid 与形近词以及表示禁止的词作比较。

entries.definition: to stop being angry with someone
to hold back from doing something
to forbid by law or rule

normalIntro.en: To forbid is to put a firm hand in front of an action.
normalIntro.cn: forbid 就是在某个动作前竖起一只坚决的手。

normal.en: Her father forbade her to leave.
The weather forbade an early start.
normal.cn: 天气使提早出发变得不可能。

abstract.en: A ban is a wall made of words.
abstract.cn: 禁令是用语言筑起的墙。

abstract.en: Forbidding something often makes it more tempting.
abstract.cn: 禁止某物常让它更诱人。

abstract.en: Some limits are set by weather, not by people.
abstract.cn: 有些限制由天气而非人设定。

examples.en: Smoking is forbidden in the hospital.
Her parents forbade her to go alone.
The storm forbade any attempt to sail.
examples.cn: 暴风雨使任何出航尝试都不可能。

dict_mnemonic.text: forbid 由 for-（否定、禁止）加 bid（命令）组成：下命令说「不许」。

root: 源自古英语 forbeodan（下令禁止），核心义「以命令挡住某事」。

sensesIntro.en: Forbid means to order against, refuse permission, or make impossible.
sensesIntro.cn: forbid 意为禁止、不准或使不可能。

core.en: A command that stops an action before it starts.
core.cn: 在行动开始前拦住它的命令。

branches.en: A rule says no smoking.
A parent refuses permission.
A storm blocks the voyage.
Rules and parents both say no.
branches.cn: 规则与父母都在说不行。

branches.en: Circumstances can forbid without speaking.
branches.cn: 环境不用开口也能禁止。

intro.en: Forbid forms a family of prohibition words.
intro.cn: forbid 形成一个表示禁止的词族。

latinIntro.en: Forbid has no Latin ancestor; Latin prohibere, to forbid, is only a semantic parallel.
latinIntro.cn: forbid 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 prohibere（禁止）只是语义对应词。

items.example: The law forbids the sale of fireworks.

items.exampleCN: 那处悬崖看上去令人生畏。
这条路没有被禁止通行。

definition_zh: 强迫；力量；武力；部队；影响力
